title: Open restricted counit factorization
statement: For any scheme map g′:X′→X, open U⊂X, complex P and derived categories on all schemes, let p,q be the projections of T=X′×X U, Q=restrict(U.ι)(P), and Pg=tensorPullback(g′)(P) [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let eQ=openRestrictionRepresentativeIso(U.ι,P) [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso], beta=openRestrictedCompositionMap(g′,U,DQ(P)) [def-pc-open-restricted-composition-map], d=openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso(g′,U,P) [def-pc-open-restricted-tensor-complex-iso] and epsilon_g,epsilon_q the specified counits [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Then beta;Lp*(epsilon_g(P)) = Lq*(eQ.inv);epsilon_q(Q);d.inv. This is the strict factorization part of the counit compatibility equation, with no stalk or cohomology, no base-change square to S and no K-flatness or invertibility assumption.

source.place: Tag 0D5S, composition of derived pullbacks; Tag 0D5U, exact restriction. Strict counit part, before stalks and cohomology.

proof.text: Apply the defining left-derived counit factorization for the chosen composition comparison to the pullback projections q followed by U.ι and p followed by g′, and use pullback.condition to identify the direct pullback functors.

Use naturality of the counit and the exact restriction adjunction to replace the q restriction factor by the inverse representative restriction isomorphism. The remaining tensor-composition comparisons are the constructed open tensor restriction square; after localization they compose to openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso. Associativity and cancellation yield the displayed factorization.

theorem openRestricted_counit_factorization
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    openRestrictedCompositionMap g' U (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).map
          ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)) =
      (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map
          (openRestrictionRepresentativeIso U.ι P).inv ≫
        (counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
        (openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso g' U P).inv
